geographic.notes: Retained Q652046 map anchor [31.259647827,30.02905021] and heading -0.7484560352 rad remain unchanged; the separate original reference point is preserved in the source record. Current named Mosque of Muhammad Ali POI and aggregate relation 446128 / feature 52776558579376 identify this mosque. The raw parent has 21 outer vertices and one four-vertex court. Twenty separate current building parts supply prayer hall, central dome/drum, four lower dome controls, four corner caps, paired rear turrets, paired minarets and eastern projecting ranges. Positive X runs southeast toward the prayer hall; the court lies at negative X, so the main court facade faces negative X. Positive Z runs southwest. Facade divisions, court colonnade bays, fountain and clock-tower architecture are picture-led estimates. Separate Al Nasser Mohammad Ibn Qalaun Mosque, Citadel fortifications, museums and other buildings stay host content.
